description: stackarmor_vdr CI record (req-boot-bootstrap-ci-record, tap#365) — the stack this plugin's own tests run in, and the one claim per-plugin CI is allowed to make: that stackarmor_vdr is correct against the dependencies it DECLARES and nothing else. Install set is exactly the depends_on closure (fedramp_20x_vdr v0.1.2, computing_core v0.10.2, compliance_core v0.8.7, each at its released tag) plus stackarmor_vdr itself, pinned at the placeholder v0.0.0 until its first release; the consumer flips the self entry to editable so the CHECKOUT under test runs. Population seeds the dependencies' own GRIFT (the timeframe rows the deadline reads) and stackarmor_vdr's. DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: every other plugin, all credentials, and any population step that reaches the network.

steps.note: The 53 timeframe rows the deadline reads.
